hero.title: Software development, artificial intelligence, and data that drive your business growth.

problem.heading: Many companies hit a wall their current technology can't solve
problem.subtext: These are the most common signs that it's time to rethink how your operation uses software and data.

scattered-data.title: Scattered, underused data
scattered-data.description: Information lives across different systems and spreadsheets, but never turns into decisions.

manual-processes.title: Manual processes that don't scale
manual-processes.description: Repetitive tasks that depend on people and could be automated with software or AI.

disconnected-systems.title: Systems that don't talk to each other
disconnected-systems.description: Lack of integration between platforms, creating duplicate work and outdated information.

no-visibility.title: No real-time visibility
no-visibility.description: Decisions made without up-to-date dashboards or reports.

services.heading: Three areas, one way of working with you
services.subtext: We combine development, artificial intelligence, and data based on what your operation actually needs.

software-development.title: Software development & systems integration
software-development.description: Web applications, APIs, and connections between platforms that don't currently talk to each other, including legacy system modernization.

applied-ai.title: Applied artificial intelligence
applied-ai.description: Chatbots and virtual assistants, process automation, and AI-powered text or document analysis.

data-analytics.title: Data & analytics
data-analytics.description: Database design and management, dashboards, and real-time reports that bring together different data sources.

process.heading: A clear process, start to finish

discovery.title: Diagnosis
discovery.description: We understand your current operation, your systems, and the specific problem you want to solve.

solution-design.title: Solution design
solution-design.description: We propose an architecture or technical approach tailored to your case, not a generic solution.

implementation.title: Implementation
implementation.description: We develop and integrate the solution with your existing systems.

support.title: Support & optimization
support.description: Ongoing support, adjustments, and continuous improvement as your needs change.

results-measurement.title: Results measurement
results-measurement.description: Tracking concrete metrics — time saved, error reduction, adoption — to validate impact.

missionVision.missionText: At Trewik, we design and build software, artificial intelligence solutions, and data architectures that solve real business problems. We combine solid engineering with cutting-edge technology so companies can operate with more intelligence, speed, and confidence in their data.
missionVision.visionText: To be the leading technology consultancy in Mexico for companies looking to modernize their systems and incorporate artificial intelligence in a practical, measurable way.
